origin.description: Set LANGUAGE until the frame exits.

arguments.name: lang
arguments.text: Language code such as en, fr, or es.

origin.details: Hyphens in the language code become underscores. When LC_ALL is C or C.UTF-8 a warning says the change has no effect.

translation.description: Set LANGUAGE until the frame exits.

arguments.name: lang
arguments.text: Language code such as en, fr, or es.

translation.details: Hyphens in the language code become underscores. When LC_ALL is C or C.UTF-8 a warning says the change has no effect. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

before = os.environ.get("LANGUAGE")
with local_language("es"):
    inside = os.environ.get("LANGUAGE")
after = os.environ.get("LANGUAGE")
return [inside, "restored" if after == before else "open"]
